USE CASES

Where this pays off in a jewellery business.

Four everyday situations, and what changes when Jwero handles them.

01

Silver items are priced per piece and per gram in the same shop.

Each product can be priced by weight at today's silver rate or at a fixed price, and the counter bills both the same way.

What changesGram items and fixed price items sit in one bill.

02

Hundreds of small silver items make counting the stock a headache.

Barcode tags and a scan based stock count show what is missing against the books for each counter or tray.

What changesCounting fast moving silver becomes a scan, not a ledger.

03

Gifting season brings many first time buyers who never come back.

Customers are saved at billing and simple journeys send a thank you and a reminder before the next gifting date.

What changesFirst time buyers hear from you again.

04

You print tags by hand for every new batch of silver.

Label templates print weight, purity and price from the product record onto barcode tags.

What changesTags come out right the first time.

QUESTIONS SILVER RETAILERS ASK

What silver retailers ask about volume selling.

What does Jwero’s silver jewellery billing software do?

Silver jewellery shop software for fast catalogues, quick reorders and high-volume billing by weight, built for silver’s speed and thin margins. It is part of Jwero One, the single plan with every module included. You start with a free trial, and your price is shown in your account when it ends.

Can it handle a very large SKU count?

Yes, the catalogue is built for high piece counts, with bulk tools and stock counts by scanning for exactly this kind of volume.

Does Jwero do counter billing for high-volume silver sales?

Scan-to-sale checkout is live, scan or search a piece, build the cart, price it at the live rate, apply a discount, take payment and generate the GST or VAT invoice, all in one flow. Returns and a reconciled cash day-close are in the same counter, and search works in transliterated Hindi, Gujarati or Tamil for fast tills. See the Counter POS.

Our margins are thin: can we really afford new software?

Measure it against the manual hours currently spent reconciling volume sales, not against a line-item cost. The Dead Stock Calculator alone often surfaces more than the subscription costs.

Can I keep the silver rate separate from gold?

Yes. You keep a rate for each metal and purity, and silver items reprice from the silver rate without touching gold. Each purity of silver can have its own rate, and the counter always bills from the rate set for today.

Can I sell silver online as well?

You can open an online store with your products, or connect Shopify or WooCommerce, and stock sold in the shop is reflected online. Products are published to each channel from one screen, so you do not list the same item twice.

Can I bring in my existing stock from Excel?

Yes. The import tool takes your sheet, maps columns to Jwero fields and creates products, so you do not type thousands of items again. We help you check the first import before you go live.
